review_mode: Independent read-only exact source and transitive-definition review; no builds or edits
findings: successfulPost starts from stepPre cost pre, installs precisely the actual child world/created/substate, computes activeWords using the actual charged memory expansion arguments, clears successful creation returnData, updates gas using natural subtraction/addition, and pushes the returned address followed by the supplied remaining stack. post_fields exposes exact surviving fields, incremented PC and unchanged environment.

actual_child_gas applies ReturnedGas.lambda_remaining at the actual child fuel to the supplied actual successful child equation. CreationGas.forwarded_fit eliminates the UInt256 conversion exactly, yielding gas<=allowance without assuming a returned-gas bound.

word_guard handles the literal WORD addition guard in CreationOutcome.finish. charged<=2^64 and gas<=L(charged)<=charged imply their sum<UInt256.size; toNat_add_of_lt is therefore justified before proving the guard cannot reject. The bound includes charged=2^64 and does not confuse this word addition with the later natural arithmetic.

settle_success uses the actual child equation only to derive returned gas; it proves the literal finish guard and result-word admission conditions from gate and the charged gas bound. It matches select/finish exactly and preserves the actual child fields; no invented successful endpoint is supplied.

post_gas derives representability of charged-L(charged)+returned from returned<=L(charged), independent of the stronger 2^64 bound. Since L(n)=n-n/64, final natural gas equals charged/64+returned exactly.

step_success rewrites the actual EVM.step(fuel+1) via admitted_equation using nonceAllowed, gate and actual stack. The child remains at fuel, with no off-by-one substitution. Both the actual post-state equation and reserve lower bound concern the same successfulPost.
assumptions_and_limits: An actual successful child result remains an explicit premise. This module proves parent settlement progress from child success; it does not independently prove initialization or collision freedom.

Nonce allowance, stack shape, value/depth/init-size gate, and charged gas<=2^64 are explicit inputs. The protocol producer must derive the numeric gas bound rather than interpreting the header comment as such a proof.
step_success is an equation for the actual pinned EVM.step; Z acceptance and surrounding X execution are not conclusions here and must be composed by the caller.
No canonical address hash, deployment history, code output identity beyond the supplied actual child result, reference semantics equivalence, or Amsterdam gas correspondence is asserted.
